name: MET
summary: MET, lethal at conception: when two carriers would produce an affected foal, the pairing simply yields no foal at all. The opposite of Overo Lethal White, which is at least born.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Two working copies. Nothing is wrong and nothing is passed on.

phenotypes.name: MET carrier
phenotypes.description: One copy of met. The horse is completely normal and there is no way to see it - but half its foals inherit the copy, and two carriers bred together are the only way embryonic lethal (met) appears.

phenotypes.name: Embryonic lethal (MET)
phenotypes.description: Two non-functional copies of MET. The embryo never develops, so the pairing produces no foal at all.
